claim: Mixpost Lite is a social media management platform with a calendar, media library, post versions and basic analytics
Lite installs with Docker, manual PHP installation, or inside an existing Laravel app
Docs recommend a public domain or subdomain because Mixpost talks to social platform servers
Repository contains the Lite version of Mixpost Pro, a commercial product
Mixpost Cloud is the same tool hosted by the vendor
Pro costs $299 (one-time payment, 1 domain or subdomain) and adds all platforms, approval flow, API, MCP
Lite publishes on Facebook Pages, Mastodon profiles and X profiles; Pro publishes on all social platforms
Approval flow, first comment, hashtag manager, post templates, API and MCP are Pro features
Contributors must keep Lite features distinct from Pro; open an issue first
Licence MIT for the Lite repository
